eps.d: Once the crowning glory of an Indian temple god, the fabulous Moonstone diamond is said to bring disaster to all who possess it.
Rachel has inherited the Moonstone from her uncle - but it vanishes when some mysterious vistors arrive at the house.
Sgt Cuff, engaged to solve the mystery of the Moonstone's disappearance, has been dismissed by Lady Verinder for suspecting Rachel.
Franklin has recovered a box from the sea. It contains a nightgown known to have been worn by the thief.
One question remains to be answered: What became of the Moonstone?
